### Recording a review (Model Girl, Rinna)

A review is the reviewer's own finding, run under their own name. Build the
packet outside the repository, look at the file, then record what you found.
`--outcome` is one of `clearly-adult`, `age-ambiguous`, `appears-minor`,
`not-assessable`. Only `clearly-adult` opens anything, and any other finding
blocks these bytes for good.

```bash
python tools/body_surface/review_packet.py --slug vroid-model-girl --out ../review/vroid-model-girl
python tools/body_surface/gates.py record --file assets/library/vroid/vroid-model-girl.vrm \
    --sha256 1a298a534c54c8f6d74ddf78de06ac1c9ecef88972552d18b9d5bf01cb7a42bb \
    --outcome <your finding> --reviewer "<your name>" --evidence "<what you looked at>" \
    --packet ../review/vroid-model-girl/packet.json
```

```bash
python tools/body_surface/review_packet.py --slug vroid-rinna --out ../review/vroid-rinna
python tools/body_surface/gates.py record --file assets/library/vroid/vroid-rinna.vrm \
    --sha256 d88320f4b0059af84ce75aed66672f4602caa376e4bd41ba454e657083b54d51 \
    --outcome <your finding> --reviewer "<your name>" --evidence "<what you looked at>" \
    --packet ../review/vroid-rinna/packet.json
```

Then commit `assets/body_surface/adult-design-reviews.json` under your name and
run `python tools/body_surface/gates.py audit --md docs/qa/CHARACTER_GATE_AUDIT.md`
again. That rewrites this file from the code, so this section goes away.

### AvatarSample_O: authoring work still required

From `docs/qa/body-state-specs/vroid-avatar-sample-o.md` (route 1). This is open
only once a `clearly-adult` review of `e5c0395b…1697` is recorded.

1. **Completed source file.** Her chest is deleted from the body mesh under the
   dress, and a band of skin is cut away by alpha (`docs/STYLING.md`). The work:
   - restore the missing upper-torso surface as part of `Body (merged)`;
   - make the alpha-cut band solid;
   - keep skin weights continuous with the surrounding body (`J_Bip_C_Chest`,
     `J_Bip_C_UpperChest`, shoulders);
   - put UVs on the existing body material;
   - change nothing else.

   The result is a new file. It is pinned under its own hash and needs its own
   review.
2. **Body-state file.** Every garment mesh absent: shoes #2, tops #3, onepiece
   #4 and #5. The body is closed in the upper, lower, thigh and shin bands.
   - Same 54 humanoid bones and node names, each within 1 mm of its rest
     position.
   - The 14 expressions are kept.
   - The 9 face and hair primitives match vertex for vertex, within 0.1 mm.
   - Same VRM1 title and authors.
3. **Delivered with:** the file's SHA-256, the artist's written statement of
   rights, and the licence it is delivered under. Before import, pre-flight it
   with `python tools/body_surface/asset_spec.py --preflight --slug
   vroid-avatar-sample-o --candidate <file.vrm> --state bare --sha256 <sha256>`.

BR1's opt-in completion (`WARDROBE_BARE_BODY_COMPLETION`) can fill the upper
band with a featureless proxy patch. Its output is tagged reconstructed and is
never registered, so no app can serve it (`docs/qa/BODY_STATE_CHARACTERS.md`).
It does not replace the artist's file.
